name: Granite Hookspine
description: Stands with the hooked tip aimed at the enemy's hilt hand, ready to take the weapon at first contact.

name: Tempered Hookend
description: Taps the tip against the thumb side of an enemy grip to numb the hand before the pull.

name: Rumblegrapnel
description: Skims the hook along the ground and flicks it up under a lowered blade.

name: Torrent Hookcrook
description: Slides forward on one heel until the enemy's hilt is within the hooked bend.

name: Ponderous Hookneck
description: Hooks the opponent's guard and pulls with the wrists and qi together until the blade leaves the hand.

name: Thorncleat
description: Pins an enemy blade to the ground between spine and tip and keeps it there under qi pressure.

name: Thornyank
description: Wraps the hook around the hilt, twists with the full arm and tears the sword away while cutting the knuckles.

name: Mayhemdisarm
description: Strips one weapon, then the next, in a single chain of hooked pulls as the opponent reaches for a spare.

name: Aegis Swordhook
description: Faces an enemy hook sword with the tip held high and the guard turned to the blade.

name: Chime Hookguard
description: Beats the opposing beard aside with a quick cut before it can close on the wrist.

name: Gustsnarl
description: Drops the wrist beneath a reaching hook and steps clear to the outside.

name: Ponderous Pulldown
description: Crosses hooked bends with the enemy's and holds the lock steady, neither pulling nor yielding.

name: Implacable Cresthook
description: Slips a trapped tip out along the enemy's own bend and hooks the wrist in return.

name: Paralyzing Hookhilt
description: Feels the enemy start a pull and yields to it, so the drag carries the puller off balance.

name: Clevisassault
description: Rolls the spine over the opposing bend to break the lock and cuts down the free arm.

name: Adamant Waning Hookcurve
description: Lets an enemy's hooking pull land, then returns the same pull through the hooked bend into his own wrist.

name: Severing Hooktip
description: Twists the locked bends against each other and sends the point through the gap into the elbow.

name: Facet Hookend
description: Leaves the guard side seemingly open to tempt a cut, with the hook ready underneath.

name: Tempered Yank
description: Flicks the tip over the enemy's hilt knob to cut the back of the hand.

name: Gust Cresthook
description: Steps along a slant past the incoming edge, shoulder low, so the cut finds only air.

name: Ponderous Disarm
description: Hauls an enemy arm toward the body with a short pull of the bend.

name: Mightcleat
description: Pries the enemy guard upward with the tip and slices the exposed ribs.

name: Toxincleat
description: Wedges the hooked tip between an enemy's guard blades with qi and spreads them, opening his line.

name: Mightsnarl
description: Springs the wrist inward from the pulled guard to cut across the ribs at close range.

name: Gyveclevis
description: Pulls steadily on a hooked guard with growing qi pressure until the opponent's cover collapses.

name: Rumble Hooklock
description: Drives the point through the gap the pull has made, finding the gap between ribs and arm.

name: Trouncing Disarm
description: Alternates pulls and cuts without pause, each stroke taking more of the opponent's cover until none remains.

name: Cleatplating
description: Holds the sword with the hook bent toward the enemy edge, ready to bind on its first touch.

name: Disarmcloak
description: Circles the hooked bend slowly around the enemy blade, drawing it onto the tip.

name: Glancing Swordhook
description: Walks through the gap beside a bound sword with the hilt hand held tight.

name: Sanguine Snarl
description: Swings the pommel spike up under the jaw when the bound enemy leans in.

name: Gyvecleat
description: Squeezes a bound blade between hook and guard and bends it toward the ground with qi.

name: Might Hooktip
description: Slides off a mutual bind to the blind side and cuts the exposed arm in one motion.

name: Clevisplating
description: Pulls a bound sword to the ground and pins it with the foot, leaving the hook free to cut.

name: Pulldown Plating
description: Holds the bound blade taut like a drawn rope while the free hand brings the pommel to bear.

name: Hookcurve Cloak
description: Stands as if holding a basin, hooks curved inward on both sides and the guards overlapping.

name: Might Hooklock
description: Stitches both tips in quick alternating thrusts at the same mark on the chest.

name: Silt Hookneck
description: Flows left then right in a smooth zigzag, like a river around stones, hooks trailing.

name: Grapnelgreave
description: Catches one wrist with each hook at the same moment and holds the two arms apart.

name: Grinding Hookcrook
description: Draws two hooks along two lines at once, one cutting while the other holds the enemy sword.

name: Iron Hookspine
description: Cuts in a closing circle with both hooks, shearing at any limb that enters the ring.

name: Hookhilt Plating
description: Locks the two hooks together at the guard and spins the pair like a wheel, striking with each tip.

name: Cleatcuirass
description: Seizes the opponent's blade arm in both hooks like talons and drives a tip into the shoulder.

name: Trouncing Yank
description: Sends one hook down each side of the opponent so the cuts meet at the centreline.

name: Hoarfrost Hookneck
description: Raises both hooks in a paired salute that doubles as a guard across the face and throat.

name: Iron Twistaway
description: Cuts inward with the left hook and follows with the right in matched time.

name: Torrent Snarl
description: Advances one foot and one hook together, then the other pair, keeping the guard doubled.

name: Quelling Yank
description: Catches both of an opponent's shoulders in the beards of the blades and pulls him in.

name: Pulldown Maelstrom
description: Crosses the hooks like shears over a single target at close range.

name: Sanguine Twistaway
description: Holds an enemy blade with the left hook and strikes twice with the right in rapid beats.

name: Hoarfrost Hookend
description: Rolls both hooks in overlapping circles in front of the body, qi thickening the roll against volleys of cuts.

name: Fastening Hookhilt
description: Traps both of an opponent's wrists at once with mirrored hooks and lifts them from the line.

name: Silencing Cresthook
description: Beats the enemy blade with one hook and pulls it out of line with the other.

name: Quelling Hoarfrost Hooktip
description: Locks the enemy blade with both hooks and drives the shared push forward through the guard.

name: Intent Hookcrook
description: Throws both hook tips forward in endless alternating stabs that cover every line of retreat.

name: Granite Hookcurve
description: Curves the body and the blade together in one easy bend, ready to yield and return.

name: Might Disarm
description: Cuts along a winding line that curves around the guard before biting at the wrist.

name: Careening Snarl
description: Pivots in a small circle around the lead foot, the sword following like water in an eddy.

name: Silencing Hookspine
description: Drags a hooked enemy blade in a long steady curve that never allows it to stop.

name: Fastening Hooklock
description: Presses a trapped blade down with growing weight, like silt settling, until the arm tires.

name: Clevisspurt
description: Slips across an opponent's line in two quick steps and cuts the unguarded hip.

name: Snarlplating
description: Hooks an advancing arm at its elbow and swings the opponent around the bend into the ground.

name: Hourclevis
description: Rolls forward in wave after wave of hooked cuts, each heavier than the last, so the foe is carried backward.

name: Thorn Hookneck
description: Perches the sword high over the shoulder with the hooked tip hanging like a talon.

name: Raging Hookguard
description: Swoops down from the perched guard and rakes the hooked point across the upper arm.

name: Torrent Swordhook
description: Hops a half pace with arms spread like short wings, landing with the hook already forward.

name: Paralyzing Disarm
description: Snatches a sword by its cross-guard with the hooked point, like a hawk taking prey.

name: Chime Swordhook
description: Beats a cut aside with a flapping motion of the guard blade and bounces back to ready.

name: Fastening Twistaway
description: Lifts a hooked enemy arm sharply upward on a wave of qi, exposing the whole flank.

name: Blazegrapnel
description: Drops onto the opponent's hilt hand from above in one steep stoop that crushes the grip.

name: Hoarfrost Hookguard
description: Seizes the opponent's shoulder with the hooked point and holds him, lifting off the guard before cutting.

name: Ponderous Yank
description: Circles the foe with short darting hooked strikes, each coming from a new height and side.

name: Splitting Hooklock
description: Hooks the lead leg and drops the whole body weight into a cut, breaking the stance at the knee.

name: Thorn Cresthook
description: Stands with the sword held loose and low, the hook bent into the breeze as if swearing to it.

name: Ironcleat
description: Flicks the tip like a gust at the opponent's wrist and withdraws before a counter.

name: Silt Twistaway
description: Glides across level ground in long low strides with the hook held out as a bearing.

name: Cleviscuirass
description: Pulls an opponent's blade across the wind with a sharp tug, disturbing their balance.

name: Harpooning Hookcurve
description: Leans forward into a steady blow of hooked strokes that gives the foe no chance to settle.

name: Hookguard Hauberk
description: Wheels the blade around the body in a swearing circle that sweeps cuts out to both sides.

name: Gyvesnarl
description: Takes a bearing along the enemy blade, hooks it, and steps along the same line to close.

name: Hamstringing Pulldown
description: Tears an enemy blade up and into the wind with a long qi-driven pull, cutting the hand free.

name: Ponderous Hookhilt
description: Charges across open ground in a running chain of hooked cuts that leaves no cover to retreat to.

name: Hookend Plating
description: Stands as if on the lip of the plateau, weight back and the hook thrown forward as a probe.

name: Might Hookcrook
description: Runs along the edge of the opponent's reach and cuts in passing at the nearest limb.

name: Torrent Pulldown
description: Falls back one pace as the cut arrives, as if the ground ended, and lets it pass.

name: Cleviscloak
description: Snags an enemy sleeve on the barb and wrenches it hard, throwing the arm off line.

name: Grapnelcuirass
description: Shears a thrust off its line with a small slicing parry along the hooked bend.

name: Hookspine Cuirass
description: Holds both hands on the hilt and the guard in front like a cliff face, taking heavy blows.

name: Suppressing Hookcrook
description: Pulls an opponent toward the plateau's edge of his own balance, then drops a cut on the neck.

name: Murkcleat
description: Lifts an enemy blade high with a rising parry that feeds qi into the pull of the hook.

name: Hookcurve Barrage
description: Slices the forearm as the hook is withdrawn, the bite coming only on the return.

name: Ponderous Hooktip
description: Hooks both ankles at the lip of a drop and tugs, tipping the opponent over it.

name: Scalding Hookguard
description: Sinks the barb under the ribs and rips upward with a leaping pull, tearing through cloth and guard.

name: Swordhook Thrash
description: Throws cut after cut from the edge of reach, never stepping into the enemy's counter.

name: Granite Cresthook
description: Holds the hooked tip at the heart for a moment, then lowers it to a ready guard.

name: Harpooning Hookend
description: Thrusts along a fixed bearing taken from the opponent's eyes to the point.

name: Vaulting Disarm
description: Sidesteps while keeping the tip on the same bearing, so the line never wavers.

name: Thorn Twistaway
description: Holds an enemy blade pinned in the bend as a sworn promise, unmoving until it is released.

name: Iron Hookneck
description: Answers a cut on the same bearing, parrying and cutting back down the one line.

name: Thorn Hookhilt
description: Presses the bound blade with unbroken qi as one holds a vow, tiring the arm behind it.

name: Gyve Hookspine
description: Pulls an enemy sword away on the bearing and cuts the arm that reaches after it.

name: Intent Yank
description: Binds the enemy blade and hammers cuts along its bearing, never releasing the lock.

name: Granite Hooktip
description: Holds the sword wide on open ground with nothing behind the shoulders to lean on.

name: Might Swordhook
description: Slashes through the gap that opens as an opponent leans into a lunge.

name: Bounding Hooklock
description: Slides one long stride forward so the hook arrives a hand's breadth before the foot.

name: Thornsnarl
description: Bends with an opponent's push like a reed and hooks the arm as it overextends.

name: Gustclevis
description: Turns the blade over the back of the hand and parries a cut that comes from behind.

name: Staggering Snarl
description: Lets a thrust overreach, then hooks the extended wrist and cuts on the pull.

name: Rumble Hooktip
description: Swings the hook in a long sweeping arc that cuts several attackers in turn at waist height.

name: Rumble Snarl
description: Hooks the lead attacker's sword mid-sweep and breaks the arc, so the rest crowd and tangle.

name: Ponderous Snarl
description: Whirls the blade around the body in hooked cuts that clear a ring around the wielder.

name: Silencing Twistaway
description: Hooks one fighter and uses the pull to travel through a line of others without cutting.
